subject: pe
title: Skill & Tactics: Foundations
welcome_lead: Sport is skills plus smart choices — let's get both right.
meta_desc: KS3 PE: open vs closed skills, basic tactics.
final_note: Skill is what you do; tactics is when.

concepts.def: A plan to beat the opponent.
Reading the play in a match.

walkthroughs.body_html: An open skill (a pass in football) changes with the situation. A closed skill (a netball free throw) is the same each time.
Tactics are the team plan: press high, hold the ball, switch the play. Tactics turn skills into results.
Smart practice with feedback beats endless reps. Mix repeated drills with game-like situations.
